O.outcome_detail: progression in analogical reasoning after feedback

cells.quote: Children who initially used less advanced strategies benefited more from each type of feedback than children who used advanced strategies at pretest.
cells.note: Initial strategy-use was treated as an indicator of ability level and analyzed as a moderator of feedback effects.
